Variations in this mod include the leatherwing bat, Giant Bat and Blight Bats which can come as part of a Vile Force.  Leatherwings are often chosen for embark animals as they can be sheared in the Tanner's Shop for early leather.  They breed quickly but beware, bats of any kind can induce unhappy thoughts in some dwarves.
